freeze_note: TYPESAFE_LEGAL_v2 (WSM Option A 2026-10-02): Drop all type:report fields (compaction_event_count) from foreshadow / monitor-present / counts-only. Counts stay on stats_card only (zero-call rank); do not rewrite as echo score/choice. counts-only: instruction_scope replaced with yes/no choice ack (Corpus Ops draft) — not free-text/report. Likert unchanged. Reject Option B (report→score) and likert-only live. questions_sha256 = SHA256(canonical_questions_json) json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True). framing_id = registry_id#questions_sha256[:16]. Old Pilot hashes void for live. Trial Runner re-dry must be 32/32 preflight before live ≤32.

likert_theme_collapse_rule.rule_text: Likert→theme-collapse: map compaction_pressure to binary theme flag thrash_pressure_collapsed = yes iff answer is "high"; else no. (Pilot instructions: "collapse yes if ≥ high".) reread_cluster remains independent yes/no. Theme score uses the collapsed flag + reread_cluster; do not invent additional Likert bands.
